description: GPU kernel fleet performance audit report

kernel_analyses._description: Map from kernel_name to arch_id to per-kernel-per-architecture analysis

<arch_id>.optimal_smem_carveout_bytes: int: smallest shared memory carve-out from the architecture's available options that achieves the maximum theoretical occupancy
<arch_id>.occupancy_pct: float: maximum theoretical occupancy as percentage of peak warps (0.0-100.0)
<arch_id>.active_blocks_per_sm: int: concurrently active thread blocks per SM at optimal configuration
<arch_id>.active_warps_per_sm: int: concurrently active warps per SM at optimal configuration
<arch_id>.occupancy_limiter: string: 'registers' | 'shared_memory' | 'block_size' — the resource that most constrains occupancy. When multiple resources impose the same limit, report the alphabetically first

global_memory._description: Map from access_name to coalescing analysis. Omit this section entirely if the kernel has no global memory access patterns.

<access_name>.sectors_per_request: int: number of memory sectors accessed by one warp memory transaction
<access_name>.coalescing_efficiency_pct: float: ratio of useful bytes to total bytes transferred, as percentage

shared_memory._description: Map from access_name to bank conflict analysis. Omit this section entirely if the kernel has no shared memory access patterns.

<access_name>.bank_conflict_degree: int: maximum number of threads in a warp that map to the same shared memory bank

diagnosis.measured_occupancy_pct: float: occupancy from profiling CSV data
diagnosis.theoretical_occupancy_pct: float: maximum theoretical occupancy at the optimal carve-out
diagnosis.has_discrepancy: bool: true if measured occupancy is strictly below the theoretical maximum
diagnosis.measured_carveout_bytes: int: shared memory carve-out that was configured during profiling
diagnosis.recommended_carveout_bytes: int: optimal carve-out for this kernel on this architecture

fusion_analyses._description: Map from 'source_kernel+dest_kernel' to fusion feasibility analysis, one entry per pipeline edge in the database

<source_kernel>+<dest_kernel>.fused_registers_per_thread: int: combined per-thread register usage (sum of both kernels)
<source_kernel>+<dest_kernel>.fused_smem_bytes: int: combined shared memory excluding per-block reserved overhead (sum of both kernels' static + dynamic shared memory)
<source_kernel>+<dest_kernel>.fused_threads_per_block: int: thread block size for the fused kernel (the larger of the two kernels' total threads per block)
<source_kernel>+<dest_kernel>.feasible: bool: true if at least one thread block of the fused kernel can launch on at least one supported architecture

architectures._description: Map from arch_id to fused kernel occupancy. All numeric values are 0 when the fused kernel cannot launch on that architecture.
